title: Platform Overview
description: Golden signals for the FastAPI app (request rate, error rate, latency percentiles) plus top-level platform business counts. First dashboard an on-call operator opens.

panels.title: Request rate (req/s)
panels.query: Count of root HTTP server spans (auto-instrumented FastAPI spans, e.g. `http.method`/`http.route` attributes present) bucketed per minute, over the FastAPI ASGI middleware spans Logfire captures automatically. No custom metric backs this — it is derived entirely from span data.
panels.notes: Backed by logfire.instrument_fastapi() auto-instrumentation, not a sacco_ metric.

panels.title: 5xx error rate (%)
panels.query: 100 * (count of HTTP server spans where response status_code >= 500) / (count of all HTTP server spans), bucketed per minute, over the same auto-instrumented FastAPI spans as the request-rate panel.
panels.notes: Uses the span's numeric HTTP status attribute; no custom metric exists for this.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)
panels.query: approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5 | 0.95 | 0.99) over HTTP server span durations, bucketed per minute, grouped by http.route where available.
panels.notes: Span duration is captured automatically by logfire.instrument_fastapi(); no custom histogram metric backs this.

panels.title: Tenants by status
panels.query: sacco_tenants_total{status=*} — latest value per status label (active/suspended/provisioning/etc.).

panels.title: Active sessions / logins (5 min)
panels.query: sum(rate(sacco_auth_login_attempts_total{outcome="success"})) over a 5-minute window, grouped by actor_type (platform_user/tenant_user/member), as a proxy for active-session churn.
panels.notes: There is no dedicated active-sessions gauge; this uses the successful-login counter as the closest available signal.
